title_en: Did you want to tell me something?
grammar_focus: 间接引语疑问句(ask whether/if、ask how/what + 陈述语序)+ 易混词辨析(Words often confused,复习 SD26-45)主考——too vs very、steal vs rob、which vs who、continuously vs continually、past vs passed、deny vs refuse;pull out、for a while、in answer to(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 牙科医生们总是在你无法作出回答的时候向你提问。我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙,叫我休息一会儿。我想说点什么,但嘴里塞满了药棉。他知道我收集火柴盒,于是问我收藏是否在增加;接着又问我兄弟近来如何,问我是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。作为对这些问题的回答,我不是点头,就是发出奇怪的声音。与此同时,我的舌头正忙着寻找刚拔掉的那颗牙的伤口。我突然非常着急起来,但却什么也说不出来。当那位牙医最后将药棉从我嘴中取出时,我总算有可能告诉他,他拔错了牙。

grammar_card.title: 间接引语疑问句 + 易混词辨析
grammar_card.intro: 把别人的疑问转述出来:一般疑问用 ask whether/if,特殊疑问用 ask + 疑问词(how/what),都用陈述语序(动词跟在主语后)。本课还复习一批容易混的词:too/very、steal/rob、which/who、past/passed 等。全用本课句子举例。

rows: He asked whether my collection was growing.
He asked how my brother was.(陈述语序)
too ill to work(太…不能)/ very ill(很)
steal a thing(偷物)/ rob a bank(抢地方/人)
flew past my window(经过)/ three hours passed(过去了)

specialRules.rule: 转述疑问句要用陈述语序:asked how my brother was(不是 how was my brother)。
steal 后接被偷的东西(steal money);rob 后接被抢的地方或人(rob a bank / rob him)。
specialRules.mark: steal 物 / rob 人或地

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did the writer become very worried?
options: His tongue told him the dentist had pulled out the wrong tooth
He had a lot of pain

passage: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer. My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while. I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool. He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing. He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London. In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises. Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been. I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything. When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.

grammar_points.name: 间接引语 ask how/what + 陈述语序

stage5.stem: "He asked me ___ my collection was growing."(间接引语一般疑问:是否)
stage5.stem_cn: 他问我收藏是否在增加。

stage5.stem: "He asked ___ I liked my new job in London."(间接引语一般疑问:是否)
stage5.stem_cn: 他问我是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。

stage5.stem: "She asked ___ I had ever been to a dentist."(间接引语一般疑问:是否)
"I wondered ___ the dentist had pulled the right tooth."(间接引语一般疑问:是否)
stage5.stem_cn: 我在想牙医是否拔对了牙。

stage5.stem: "He asked me ___ my brother was."(间接引语特殊疑问:怎么样)
"He asked me how my brother ___."(转述后动词跟在主语后,不倒装)
"He is ___ ill to do any work."(太…以致不能做某事)
"The soup is ___ hot, and I like it that way."(仅表'很',中性)
stage5.stem_cn: 这汤很烫,我就喜欢这样。

stage5.stem: "The bank ___ last night."(抢劫银行/某人)
"My wallet ___ on the bus."(偷走某物)
stage5.stem_cn: 我的钱包在公交车上被偷了。

stage5.stem: "The new school, ___ has just been completed, is fine."(先行词指物时)
stage5.stem_cn: 刚建成的新学校很不错。

stage5.stem: "The dentist ___ pulled my tooth was very kind."(先行词指人时)
stage5.stem_cn: 给我拔牙的牙医很和善。

stage5.stem: "The ship sailed ___ across the sea for three days."(连续不间断地)
stage5.stem_cn: 船连续不断地航行了三天。

stage5.stem: "He ___ interrupts me when I speak."(反复地、时断时续地)
stage5.stem_cn: 我说话时他不断打断我。

stage5.stem: "A bird flew ___ my window."(从…旁边经过,表方位)
"Three hours ___ before he came back."(时间'过去了',用动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 过了三个小时他才回来。

stage5.stem: "He ___ that he had taken it."(否认做过某事)
"He ___ to answer the question."(拒绝做某事)
